title: Phase 1 extractor fix for REST EP guard resolution (DI-26-01) + S5 for cartflows/pretty-link

dependencies.reason: change_manifest_session_26.json status=COMPLETED required. Option D benchmark active, gate artifacts final, S5 for backwpup complete.

critical_notes: E1: source_ref wins over spec if they conflict. E4: Python null discipline in compare.py. E5: no scope expansion.

DI-26-01 is the BLOCKER: Phase 1 extractor cannot resolve __array_callable__ permission_callbacks to guard entries for REST EPs. All 22 backwpup TP-claimed findings remain UNCERTAIN because guard_consistent=0.1. DO NOT patch guard_consistent logic — it is correct. Fix the Phase 1 extractor.

DI-26-01 fix location: the REST route extractor in tools/bin/ or the Phase 1 analysis scripts. Search for the code that emits permission_callback=__array_callable__ and extend it to resolve array callables.
After DI-26-01 fix: rerun Phase 1 for backwpup, rerun Phase 3 gate, verify guard_consistent improves for REST EPs, rerun benchmark.
DI-26-02 (LLM markdown contract format mismatch) is LOW priority — fix only if time permits in Session 27.
S5 for cartflows and pretty-link: run after DI-26-01 is resolved (so gate output reflects real guard state).
Do not add new plugins or expand scope beyond backwpup DI-26-01 fix in Session 27.

DI-26-01.file: tools/bin/phase1_extractor.py (or equivalent Phase 1 script that processes REST routes)
DI-26-01.change: Extend the permission_callback resolver to handle array callable syntax ([$class_or_obj, 'method_name']). When a REST route's permission_callback is an array callable, resolve it to a function name and emit the corresponding guard entry (type=capability_check or nonce_check) in the IR. If the callable cannot be statically resolved, emit a guard with is_effective=None (unknown) rather than __array_callable__ placeholder.
DI-26-01.test: After fix: rerun `python3 tools/bin/phase1_extractor.py backwpup` (or equivalent). Verify that IR for backwpup has guard entries for at least some of the 16 REST EPs. Rerun phase3_gate.py for backwpup. Verify guard_consistent score improves above 0.1 for REST EP findings. Rerun benchmark/compare.py --all and check if TP count changes.

S5-CARTFLOWS-PRETTYLINK.change: Run S5 (Claude Code Verify) for cartflows and pretty-link after DI-26-01 is resolved and gate artifacts are final. Output: reports/phase3/cartflows-s5-verify.json and reports/phase3/pretty-link-s5-verify.json.
S5-CARTFLOWS-PRETTYLINK.note: Only run after DI-26-01 fix is confirmed and gate re-run is complete.

DI-26-02-optional.change: Fix validate_markdown() to accept both '- Type:' bullet format and '**Type:**' bold format. Or update phase3-prompt-template.md to explicitly require '- Type:' bullet format with example.
DI-26-02-optional.note: LOW priority — review JSON is fully populated regardless of markdown format. Only fix if time permits in Session 27.
